name: Sigma

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sigma, also published as Sigma Sathish, is a poet and English-language academic associated with Trivandrum. A Setu contributor profile connects her teaching at VTMNSS College with an earlier post in Oman, while Kalinga Literary Festival’s speaker biography also records her work as an editor and reviewer. The festival names Feminine Blues among her poetry books.

“Listen to me” begins with a world reduced to a web and dreams confined within four walls. The speaker’s wishes are modest and sensory: shared walks, the smell of rain on earth, the shimmer of dew. These open outward from isolation, before the remembered pink shirt brings the poem back to one absent person. Its closing question leaves the tension between desire and detachment unresolved.
